places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: Augustus walks past the Pumphreys' store to the Dry Bean, plays cards late, and lends Dish two dollars before the cowboy heads up to Lorena.
places.location_hint: south Texas border town on the Rio Grande, roughly a hundred miles upriver from Matamoros

places.name: Hat Creek
places.note: Augustus pauses on its dry sandy bed to buckle on his pistol on the way into town.
places.location_hint: between the Hat Creek outfit's wagon yard and the main street of Lonesome Dove

places.name: Tennessee
places.note: Augustus compares its misty nights to dry border nights and remembers card games with his sisters there.

places.name: Republican River
places.note: The Pumphrey daughter's young husband drowned in it the previous fall.

places.name: Mexico City
places.note: Lippy plays his favorite song so loudly he seems to want it heard there.

places.name: New Orleans
places.note: Xavier's birthplace, where he once worked in a restaurant with tablecloths; Shanghai Pierce goes there to take the train north.

places.name: Texas
places.note: Xavier came believing it a land of opportunity; cowhands argue whether Augustus or Shanghai Pierce is louder.

places.name: San Antonio
places.note: Lippy found his battered bowler hat lying on the road there years ago.

places.name: Philadelphia
places.note: Lippy's hat bears a Philadelphia maker's label, which he takes as proof of quality.

places.name: Matamoros
places.note: Dish delivered horses there and lost a month's pay gambling before riding about a hundred miles upriver.

places.name: Abilene
places.note: Trail town where Dish imagines buying Lorena a present.

places.name: Dodge City
places.note: Dish usually brings back ribbons and combs from there for Mexican girls.

places.name: St. Louis
places.note: Lippy grew up there and wishes he could go back.

groups.label: Dry Bean regulars
groups.hint: at the Dry Bean saloon; Dish upstairs with Lorena, about to leave with a trail outfit next week
